name: aicode-cli-mvp
description: A local Claude-Code-like CLI coding agent MVP.

scripts.smoke: npm run build && node dist/src/index.js --provider mock --approval auto --session-dir .aicode-smoke/sessions --prompt "smoke multi-tool task: inspect, write, read, and run command"
scripts.open: npm run build && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/open-aicode.ps1
